items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; specific specimen identified as 前7.36.2 / 合12532
items.caption: A modern digital rendering labeled as the Shang oracle-bone form of 气; its linked Sinica source identifies specimen 前7.36.2 / 合12532. The historical interpretation of this form is disputed.
items.alt: Three horizontal strokes, with the middle stroke shorter, rendered as an oracle-bone-style graph for 气.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early form whose referent and proposed cloud-vapor interpretation are discussed and disputed in the inspected paleographic sources.
items.rights: Commons description states public-domain status and identifies the Sinica glyph image as CC0 1.0.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; traditional dictionary form, conventionally associated with the Han dictionary tradition
items.tradition: Small seal script, modern digital redraw
items.caption: A modern digital rendering labeled as 氣 in Shuowen seal script, showing the 米-plus-气 form analyzed in Shuowen as a grain-gift graph with 气 as phonetic.
items.alt: A seal-script form of 氣 with a rice-related 米 component and the 气 component above.
items.selection_reason: Illustrates the traditional dictionary analysis of 氣 and its component structure; it is not presented as an excavated artifact image.
items.rights: Commons description states public-domain status and identifies the Sinica glyph image as CC0 1.0.

limitations.text: These files are modern digital drawings identified by their description pages, not photographs or direct scans of ancient artifacts. The oracle-bone glyph’s original referent is disputed.
